item.title: Pantograph 1.1.8
item.description:
New

  • Drag the picture to move the window. When the whole picture fits, dragging it moves the window. Zoomed in (or when it's bigger than the window), dragging still moves around the picture.
  • Clicks show where they went. Clicking the left or right side flashes an arrow on that side, and the first time, a short note explains that clicking moves through the folder.
  • Clicking through photos skips videos and PDFs. A folder of photos with a few videos or PDFs in it now steps through just the photos; animated GIFs stay in. Open a video or PDF to step through those instead.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself (1.1.7 and later install it quietly when you quit). Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.1.8.zip, unzip it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
